subject: [PATCH 09/10] mm/madvise: make cold and pageout PTE lock ownership explicit

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch refactors the madvise_lru_pte_range_locked function to explicitly manage PTE lock ownership, making it clear who holds the lock during page-walking and huge PMD handling. The original code mixed lock ownership between the PMD callback and the page-walk callback, which is now separated into two distinct functions. This change does not introduce any functional changes but improves the clarity of the code by explicitly managing lock ownership.
